title: F. Scott & Zelda Fitzgerald Museum

services.name: Private Events Booking
services.desc: The Scott and Zelda Fitzgerald Museum, located in historic Cloverdale, is the only museum dedicated to the lives and legacies of Scott and Zelda Fitzgerald. The early 1900s Lockwood home housed the Fitzgerald family in the early thirties and now provides a beautiful venue for your special event. Choose from one of our diverse packages that will best suit your event’s needs. The Azalea package includes access to the spacious, half-acre lawn and gardens as well as restrooms indoors. The Camelia package is ideal for birthday parties or gatherings with a capacity of around 150. Does not include set up or clean up. Renters are responsible for all set up and clean up.
